newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Rugby Union - Blackadder at lock for Canterbury.
newsitem.headline: Rugby Union - Blackadder at lock for Canterbury.

text.p: CHRISTCHURCH, Sept 5 - All Black Todd Blackadder returns to the Canterbury rugby team as captain but in a new position for the NPC first division rugby match against King Country at Lancaster Park on Friday night.

NZPA reports that Blackadder will be at lock in place of the injured Steve Lancaster for the bottom-of-the-table match after playing his other 66 matches for Canterbury at either No 8 or on the flank.
Blackadder, who stands 1.9m, said yesterday he was not fazed at joining the pack's engine room despite his lack of experience at lock.
"I'd play in any position to help the team out," said Blackadder, who assumes the captaincy from prop Stu Loe.
Fellow All Black Andrew Mehrtens will sit out the match, however, as there is still some concern over his knee injury and coach Vance Stewart wants him to take more time to recover.

Of Canterbury's other All Blacks, halfback Justin Marshall is likely to play ahead of Barry Matthews, centre Tabai Matson replaces the injured Mark Mayerhofler and prop Con Barrell is preferred to Richard Loe.
The other change to the team that has lost its opening two NPC games to Counties and Wellington sees the seasoned Kieren Flynn coming in ahead of Graeme Dempster.
Blackadder was on the sideline when Canterbury's aspirations of making the championship semifinals came to grief against King Country at Te Kuiti last year.
It was the only match he missed last season and he almost had to be restrained from charging on to the field as Canterbury suffered a record 38-28 loss.
"It's important we win against King Country. We were all disappointed what happened last year and want to fix that on Friday," he said.
"The guys had a yarn about it last night and are focused.
"We're two down after two and the only way to go now is up. I believe we can still get into the championship and make the top four."

Canterbury: Simon Forrest, Paula Bale, Tabai Matson, Brad Fleming, Daryl Gibson, Kieran Flynn, Justin Marshall or Barry Matthews, Steve Surridge, Angus Gardiner, Craig Philpott, Todd Blackadder (captain), Scott Robertson, Con Barrell, Mark
Hammett, Stu Loe. Reserve: Marshall or Matthews, Nick Little, Mike Tamati, Matt Sexton, Richard Loe, Brian Hutchinson, Dan Charteris.
